title: A Witness for the Parish
author: Juniper Fairweather
blurb: Edmund Amberdale, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
